question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"****historic."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "historic" means famous or important in history. (इतिहास में महत्वपूर्ण, ऐतिहासिक)

 
 
• Example: *The ending of apartheid was a **historic**__ event.*
 
 
 
• *​*The paragraph conveys that India achieved their greatest-ever performance at the Games, starting on the first day of competition with Mirabai Chanu's weightlifting silver medal and ending on the last day of competition in Tokyo with Neeraj Chopra's momentous gold medal in the javelin throw.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

The build up to the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, which __began__ on July 23 and finished on August 8, as defined by cautious optimism, as well as a slew of __anxiety__ that came with staging the Games under tight safety standards and without __spectators__ during the COVID-19 outbreak. While Indian competitors had shown enough potential to __legitimately__ expect a big return of medals in the Games, the disappointments of Rio 2016 lingered. What happened was that India delivered its best-ever performance at the Games, beginning with Mirabai Chanu's silver medal in weightlifting on the first day and culminating with Neeraj Chopra's __**historic**__ gold medal in javelin throw on the country's last day of competition in Tokyo.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Insignificant: **of little value or importance. (महत्वहीन, उपेक्षणीय, नगण्य, निरर्थक)
 
• **Asiatic: **relating to or deriving from Asia. (एशिया से संबंधित या व्युत्पन्न)
 
• **Non-fictional: **writing that is about real events and facts, rather than stories that have been invented. (ऐसा लेखन जो आविष्कार की गई कहानियों के बजाय वास्तविक घटनाओं और तथ्यों के बारे में हो)
